description: v2 drug -> PubChem CID (from the ChEMBL parent), and for P35-train drugs the SIDER flat/stereo ids matched by sider_labels.match_stereo. P35 held-out drugs carry no SIDER field; P35.4 recomputes it host-side.

sider.release: SIDER 4.1 (Kuhn et al. 2016, Nucleic Acids Res 44:D1075, PMID 26481350)

provenance.resolution: ChEMBL standard_inchi_key -> PubChem CID; if none, PubChem fastidentity same_stereo_isotope on ChEMBL canonical_smiles; connectivity CIDs by fastidentity same_connectivity
